bear.claim: Revenue growth was +11.8% YoY in FY26, missing the 15% target.
bear.why: Weakens earnings outlook and credibility of guidance.

bear.claim: EBITDA margin slipped to 8.7% in Q2 FY27, down 1.3 pp YoY.
bear.why: Erodes profitability and cash conversion efficiency.

bear.claim: Analysts flagged inflation and supply‑chain constraints as key risks.
bear.why: Could compress margins and delay project execution.

bear.claim: Trailing 12‑month ROE fell to 16.1% in Q1 FY27, down from 17%.
bear.why: Indicates weakening return on equity and capital efficiency.

bull.claim: Group order inflows reached Rs. 1,080 billion, up 14% YoY in Q1 FY27.
bull.why: Boosts top‑line growth and future revenue visibility.

bull.claim: Revenue grew 11.4% YoY in FY27 so far.
bull.why: Supports earnings expansion and cash generation.

bull.claim: Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio improved to 4.1% in March 2026.
bull.why: Reduces balance‑sheet risk and frees cash for projects.

bull.claim: Debt/equity fell to 1.15 at FY26 end, down from 1.52.
bull.why: Lowers financial leverage and interest‑cost burden.
